content: Modafinil is a medication commonly prescribed to manage excessive daytime sleepiness (EDS). It is classified as a wakefulness-promoting agent and is often used in conditions such as narcolepsy, obstructive sleep apnea (OSA), and shift work sleep disorder (SWSD). The drug works by influencing certain neurotransmitters in the brain, including dopamine, to enhance alertness and reduce the overwhelming urge to sleep during the day. Modafinil is generally well-tolerated, but potential side effects may include headache, nausea, nervousness, or insomnia. It is important for patients to use modafinil under the guidance of a healthcare professional, as it may interact with other medications or underlying health conditions.
